Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:10:1.english: It was stated - [This is the] reading:

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:10:2.hebrew: קידושין שאין מסורין לביאה - קידש אחת משתי אחיות, ולא פירש איזוהי מהם, דאין יכול לישא אחת מהן, דשמא זו היא אחות אשתו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:10:2.english: Betrothal that is not given to consummation - [Where] one betrothed one of two sisters and did not specify which of them [he betrothed], for he cannot marry either of them, lest this [one] is his wife's sister.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:10:3.hebrew: בר אהינא אסברא לי - הבינני דבר זה, שיכולני להביא לו ראיה מן התורה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:10:3.english: Bar Ahina explained it to me - He made me understand this matter, that I can bring a proof for it from the Torah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:10:4.hebrew: כי יקח איש - דהיינו קידושי כסף, דגמרינן להו (לעיל קידושין דף ב.) ״קיחה״ ״קיחה״, וכתיב ״ובעלה״ — דבעינן ראויה לביאה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:10:4.english: “When a man takes” - That is, betrothal through money, which we derive (above, Kiddushin 2a) [from the verbal analogy of] “taking,” “taking”; and it is written: “And has intercourse with her” — [indicating] that we require [that she be] fit for intercourse.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:11:1.hebrew: כאחת - הוא דאינן מקודשות, משום דכל שאינו בזה אחר זה, אפי' בבת אחת אינו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:11:1.english: As one - It is [specifically when betrothed] as one that they are not betrothed, because whatever cannot [take effect] one after the other cannot [take effect] even simultaneously.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:11:2.hebrew: הא אחת מאשה ובתה - ולא פירש, מקודשת:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:11:2.english: But one of a woman and her daughter - And he did not specify [which one] — she is betrothed.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:12:1.english: But unrelated women - [Those] who are with them are betrothed.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:13:1.hebrew: קני את וחמור הוא - נותן מתנות לנולד ולעובר שבמעי אמו, שאינו קונה כלום — גם הנולד אינו קונה, שהרי לא הקנה לזה בלא זה. והכא נמי, איכא חדא דלא חזיא ליה כלל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:13:1.english: It is [a case of] "acquire, you and a donkey" - [Like] one who gives gifts to [a person already] born and to a fetus in its mother's womb, which cannot acquire anything — the one who is born does not acquire either, for he did not transfer [ownership] to this one without that one. And here too, there is one [woman] who is not suitable for him at all:

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:1:1.hebrew: המרבה במעשרות - המפריש אחד מחמשה — שמנה ארבעה לחולין בצד זה, ומדד חמישית למעשר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:1:1.english: One who increases tithes - One who separates one [measure] out of five, in that he counted four [measures] for non-sacred [produce] on this side, and measured a fifth [measure] for tithe.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:1:2.hebrew: מעשרותיו מקולקלין - דטבל ומעשר מעורבין זה בזה, שהכרי כולו טבל הוה. וכשמנה ארבעה לחולין, לא היה לו ליטול מן הכרי למעשר אלא חצי מדה חמישית, והוא הפריש מדה שלמה, ושם מעשר לא חל עליו אלא כפי חשבון, ונמצא השאר טבל, ואסור לכל אדם עד שיתקננה. ואם איתא דכל שאינו בזה אחר זה אינו בבת אחת כלל — אמאי פירותיו מתוקנין, ולמה חל שם מעשר אפי' לפי חשבון? הרי אינו בזה אחר זה, שאם הפריש פעם אחת וחזר והפריש, לא היה שם מעשר חל על האחרון:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:1:2.english: His tithes are ruined - For tevel and tithe are mixed with each other, as the entire pile was tevel. And when he counted four [measures] for non-sacred produce, he should only have taken from the pile for tithe half of the fifth measure, yet he separated a full measure. And the designation of tithe took effect upon it only according to the calculation, and [consequently] the remainder is found to be tevel, and is forbidden to everyone until he rectifies it. And if it is so that anything that cannot [take effect] sequentially cannot [take effect] at all simultaneously — why is his produce rectified, and why did the designation of tithe take effect even according to the calculation? Behold, it cannot [take effect] sequentially, for if he had separated once and then separated again, the designation of tithe would not have taken effect upon the latter.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:1:3.hebrew: וליתנהו בזה אחר זה - שאם שחטה על ארבעים חלות, וחזר ואמר על ארבעים אחרות ״יקדשו גם אלו עם אלו״ — לא קדשו, שהתודה טעונה ארבעים חלות, כדאמרינן במנחות (דף עו.), ושחיטת הזבח מקדשתן קדושת הגוף, כדאמרינן התם (דף עח:): ״קרבנו על זבח״ — מלמד שאין הלחם קדוש אלא בזביחה; דהאי ״קרבנו״ בלחם משתעי, דכתיב: ״על חלות לחם חמץ יקריב קרבנו״ וגו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:1:3.english: And they cannot [take effect] sequentially - For if he slaughtered [the thanksgiving offering] over forty loaves, and then said concerning forty others, "Let these too be consecrated along with those," they are not consecrated. For a thanksgiving offering requires forty loaves, as we say in Menachot (76a), and the slaughter of the sacrifice consecrates them with inherent sanctity, as we say there (78b): "[He shall present] his offering upon the sacrifice" — this teaches that the bread is consecrated only through slaughtering [the sacrifice], for this [word] "his offering" speaks of the bread, as it is written: "With cakes of leavened bread he shall present his offering..." (Leviticus 7:13).

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:2:1.hebrew: דאם אמר תתקדש פלגא פלגא דחיטתא קדשה - הלכך, כשהפריש בבת אחת יותר מכשיעור, יש לו למעשר לחול על כל חטה וחטה לפי חשבון, ואיכא למימר דנתפשו כולהו לפי חשבון. אבל גבי אחיות, ליכא למימר נתפשו קצת קידושין אכל חדא וחדא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:2:1.english: For if one said, “Let half, half of a grain of wheat be consecrated,” it is consecrated - Therefore, when one separated all at once more than the [prescribed] measure, the tithe can take effect upon each and every grain proportionally, and one can say that all of them were affected proportionally. But regarding [two] sisters, one cannot say that partial betrothal took effect on each and every one.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:3:1.hebrew: דליכא לחצאין - כשמנה תשעה, אינו יכול להוציא שנים ולומר: חצי כל אחד יהא מעשר ויקרב — לחצאין. וליתא נמי בזה אחר זה — שאחר שקרא לעשירי עשירי, וחזר וקרא לאחד עשר עשירי, אינו קדוש:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:3:1.english: Which does not [take effect] in halves - When he counted nine, he cannot bring out two and say, “Half of each one shall be tithe and be sacrificed” — in halves. And nor does it [apply] sequentially — for after he called the tenth “tenth,” and then called the eleventh “tenth,” [the eleventh] is not holy.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:3:2.hebrew: ואחד עשר מעורבין - אחד מהן מעשר גמור, אבל אינו ידוע איזה הוא. והשני, שם שלמים עליו, כדין אחד עשר שקרא עשירי אחר שטעה וקרא לעשירי תשיעי, דקי"ל שהוא שלמים, כדלקמן. האי הוי נמי שלמים, שהרי אחד עשר זה, אף הוא אחר קריאת תשיעי נקרא עשירי, והרי הן מעורבים. וירעו עד שיסתאבו, ויביא בהמת חולין ויאמר: "כ"מ שהן שלמים יהא מחולל על בהמה זו", ויקרב זו שלמים, והשנים נאכלין לבעלים, ששניהם ספק מעשר, ומעשר בהמה נאכל במומו לבעלים. והא הכא, דאינו בזה אחר זה — דאילו קרא לעשירי עשירי, לא קדש אחד עשר כלל — וכי קראהו בהדדי, חשיב חד מינייהו מעשר לפטור את התשעה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:3:2.english: And the eleventh are intermingled - One of them is full tithe, but it is not known which one it is; and the second has the status of a peace-offering upon it, in accordance with the law of an eleventh [animal] that one called "tenth" after erring and calling the tenth "ninth," where we maintain that it is a peace-offering, as [explained] below. This one is also a peace-offering, for this eleventh [animal], it too was called "tenth" after the calling of "ninth"; and behold, they are intermingled. And they must graze until they develop a blemish, and he brings an unconsecrated animal and says: "Wherever the peace-offering is, let it be deconsecrated onto this animal," and he offers this [one] as a peace-offering, and the two [animals] are eaten by the owners, as both of them are of uncertain tithe [status], and animal tithe is eaten in its blemish by the owners. And behold here, where it cannot [take effect] sequentially — for had he called the tenth "tenth," the eleventh would not have been consecrated at all — yet when he called them simultaneously, one of them is considered tithe to exempt the nine:

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:4:1.hebrew: שאני מעשר דאיתיה בטעות - אם טעה מלקרות העשירי בשמו, הוי מעשר. דתנן: [קרא] לתשיעי ״עשירי״, ולעשירי ״תשיעי״, ולאחד עשר שבא אחריו של זה קרא ״עשירי״ — (עד) שלשתן מקודשין. וסוף המשנה: תשיעי נאכל במומו, והעשירי מעשר, ואחד עשר קרב שלמים; ויליף לה מקראי. הלכך, כי היכי דחל שמו על הטעות, חל נמי כי נפיק אחד עשר בהדיה, ולא הפסיד העשירי את שמו בכך. אבל קידושין, דליתנהו בטעות — אינו בזה אחר זה; בכל מקום שאינו, בבת אחת אינו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:4:1.english: Animal tithe is different, as it [takes effect] in [the case of] an error - If he erred by not calling the tenth by its [proper] name, it is [nevertheless] tithe. As we learned [in a mishna]: [If he called] the ninth "tenth," and the tenth "ninth," and the eleventh that came after this one he called "tenth" — (until) all three of them are consecrated. And the end of the mishna [states]: The ninth is eaten with its blemish, and the tenth is tithe, and the eleventh is sacrificed as a peace-offering; and it derives this from verses. Therefore, just as its designation takes effect upon an error, it likewise takes effect when the eleventh emerges along with it, and the tenth did not lose its designation thereby. But betrothal, which does not [take effect] in [the case of] an error, cannot [take effect] sequentially; [and] anywhere that it cannot [take effect sequentially, it does] not [take effect] simultaneously.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:1.english: And behold, a thanks-offering - [This refers to] the loaves of a thanks-offering.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:2.hebrew: דליתנהו בטעות - שאם שחט תודה על ארבעים חלות, ונתכוון לשחורות ונמצאו לבנות, שאינן אותן שבדעתו — לא קדשו. דתנן (נזיר דף לא.): הקדש טעות — ב"ש אומרים: הקדש, וב"ה אומרים: אינו הקדש:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:2.english: Which are not [consecrated] in error - For if one slaughtered a thanks-offering over forty loaves, and intended [to consecrate] black ones, but they turned out to be white — which were not those that were in his mind — they are not consecrated. As we learned in a Mishnah (Nazir 31a): Consecration in error — Beit Shammai say: It is consecrated; and Beit Hillel say: It is not consecrated.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:3.hebrew: וליתנהו בזה אחר זה - שאם שחטה על ארבעים חלות, וחזר ואמר על ארבעים אחרות: "יקדשו גם אלו עם אלו" — לא קדשו; שהתודה טעונה ארבעים חלות, כדאמרינן במנחות (דף עו.), ושחיטת הזבח מקדשתן קדושת הגוף, כדאמרינן התם (דף עח:): "קרבנו על זבח" — מלמד שאין הלחם קדוש אלא בזביחה; דהאי "קרבנו" בלחם משתעי, דכתיב: "על חלות לחם חמץ יקריב קרבנו" וגו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:3.english: And they are not [consecrated] sequentially - That if he slaughtered it accompanied by forty loaves, and then said regarding another forty, "Let these also be consecrated with those," they are not consecrated. For the thanks-offering requires forty loaves, as we say in Menaḥot (76a), and the slaughter of the sacrifice consecrates them with bodily sanctity, as we say there (78b): "'His offering upon the sacrifice' — this teaches that the bread is consecrated only through slaughter"; for this [word] "his offering" refers to the bread, as it is written: "With cakes of leavened bread he shall present his offering" etc.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:4.english: [Accompanied] by eighty loaves - He brought eighty [loaves] alongside it into the [Temple] courtyard.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:5.hebrew: קדשו ארבעים מתוך שמונים - ויוצא ידי תודתו, והתם מפרש היכי מתאכלים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:5.english: Forty of the eighty are consecrated - And he fulfills [the obligation of] his thanks-offering, and there [in Menaḥot] it explains how they are eaten.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:6.hebrew: לא קדשו - קא סלקא דעתך בדרבה פליגי, דאמר: ״כל שאינו בזה אחר זה אינו בבת אחת״, ומקשי לה מדחזקיה, שהיה רבו של ר' יוחנן, כדאמרינן בעירובין (דף כד.) גבי סנדל שנפסקה אחת מתרסיותיו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:5:6.english: Are not consecrated - You might think that they disagree regarding [the principle of] Rabba, who said: “Anything that cannot [take effect] sequentially cannot [take effect] simultaneously”; and [the Gemara] raises an objection against him from [the statement of] Ḥizkiya, who was the teacher of Rabbi Yoḥanan, as we say in Eruvin (24a) regarding a sandal one of whose straps tore:

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:6:1.hebrew: היכא דאמר וכו' - כלומר, היכא דלא נתכוון שיקדשו אלא ארבעים, ואת השאר הביא לאחריות — שאם יאבדו או יטמאו אלו, יהו אלו תחתיהן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:6:1.english: Where he said, etc. - That is to say, where he did not intend that more than forty should be consecrated, and the rest he brought as a guarantee — so that if these are lost or become ritually impure, these [others] will be in their place.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:6:2.hebrew: לא יקדשו - כלומר, לא נתכוון שיקדשו ארבעים בלא שמנים, שבדקנוהו ואמר: ״(לכולכם) נתכוונתי״:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:6:2.english: [Forty] shall not be consecrated - That is to say, he did not intend that forty should be consecrated without eighty, as when we examined him and he said: “[It was] for all of you [loaves that] I intended.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:6:3.hebrew: לא קדשו - כדרבה, דכל שאינו בזה אחר זה, אינו בבת אחת:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:6:3.english: They are not consecrated - In accordance with [the principle of] Rabba, that anything that cannot [take effect] sequentially cannot [take effect] simultaneously.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:7:1.english: Without specification - Where he slaughtered [the offering] without specifying, and went on his way:

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:7:2.english: He intends [them] as a guarantee - And he had in mind only forty [loaves].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:7:3.english: A large offering - And his mind was on all of them.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:8:1.hebrew: ורבא למה ליה לשנויי - לעיל טעמא דמתני' דקתני אינה מקודשת, כדרבה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:8:1.english: And why did Rava need to explain - Earlier, the reason of the Mishnah, which teaches: "She is not betrothed," in accordance with [the opinion of] Rabba?

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:8:2.hebrew: תיפוק ליה - דאפי' לא קידש אלא אחת מהן, אלא שלא פירש איזו היא — אית ליה לרבא דאינה מקודשת, דקידושין שאין מסורין לביאה הן, שאין ידוע איזה מהן אחות אשה. ושמעינן ליה לרבא דאמר לקמן: קידושין שאין ראויין לביאה אינן קידושין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:8:2.english: Let him derive it - For even if he betrothed only one of them, but merely did not specify which one she is, Rava holds that she is not betrothed, as it is a betrothal that is not given to consummation, for it is not known which of them is [the] wife’s sister. And we have heard Rava say later: Betrothal that is not fit for consummation is not betrothal.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:9:1.hebrew: לדבריו דרמי בר חמא קאמר לה - לדידך, דילפת ליה מהאי קרא, לא תוקמא לקרא בבת אחת — דקשיא "ונכרתו" — אלא אוקמי בזה אחר זה, והדר תיפוק לך בבת אחת דמתני' מיניה וביה, משום דרבה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51a:9:1.english: He stated it in accordance with the statement of Rami bar Ḥama - According to you, who derive it from this verse, do not establish the verse [as referring to betrothal] simultaneously, for "and they shall be cut off" poses a difficulty; rather, establish it [as referring to betrothal] sequentially, and then you can derive [the case of] "simultaneously" of our Mishnah from [the verse] itself, on account of [the principle] of Rabba.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 51a:10:1.hebrew: קידושין שאין מסורין לביאה רבא אמר לא הוו קידושין - פי' בקונטרס: דכתיב "ובעלה", דבעינן ראויין לביאה. וקשה, דהא חייבי לאוין אינם ראוין לביאה, ותפסי בהו קידושין! לכך נראה לפרש: "קידושין שאין מסורין לביאה" — כלומר, שאיסור הביאה ע"י קידושין; והיינו היכא דקידש אחת משתי אחיות בסתם, שמקודם הקידושין היתה כל אחת מהן מותרת, ועכשיו ע"י הקידושין נאסרו שתיהן. אבל חייבי לאוין, איסור הביאה לא באה ע"י הקידושין, שהרי מקודם לכן נאסרו בביאה כמו אחר הקידושין:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 51a:10:1.english: Betrothal that is not given to consummation, Rava says: It is not betrothal - [Rashi] explained in the Kunteres that it is written: “And engages in sexual intercourse with her” (Deuteronomy 24:1), [indicating] that we require [them to be] fit for intercourse. And this is difficult, for [women forbidden by] negative commandments are not fit for intercourse, yet betrothal takes effect with them! Therefore, it seems [correct] to explain "betrothal that is not given to consummation" — meaning that the prohibition of intercourse [arises] through the betrothal; and that is where one betrothed one of two sisters without specifying [which one], for prior to the betrothal each of them was permitted [to him], and now, through the betrothal, both of them became forbidden [to him]. But [in the case of women forbidden by] negative commandments, the prohibition of intercourse did not come about through the betrothal, as prior to it they were forbidden for intercourse just as [they are] after the betrothal.
